name: Vision (local OCR/describe)
description: Image description and OCR via local Ollama vision models (gemma3:4b primary, gemma3:12b fallback). Used by the attachment router when an image is dropped and Ollama is the active agent. Claude/Gemini handle images natively; this is the offline alternative.

presets.name: Describe image
presets.args_template: run gemma3:4b 'Describe this image in detail, including any visible text. Image: {INPUT}'
presets.description: Verbose natural-language description of an image's content

presets.name: OCR (extract text)
presets.args_template: run gemma3:4b 'Extract ALL text visible in this image, preserving layout where possible. Output only the extracted text. Image: {INPUT}'
presets.description: Extract printed/handwritten text from an image

presets.name: Describe image (12B fallback)
presets.args_template: run gemma3:12b 'Describe this image in detail, including any visible text. Image: {INPUT}'
presets.description: Higher-quality description using gemma3:12b (uses more VRAM)
